title: Record the slot-free P104 consumer's coverage credit floor.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Author-checked screen for the slot-free consumer of the PR3882 encoding `(w, q, v_N)`. No new κ and no selected-frontier change. The selected conditional exponent remains `605457647/200000000000`.

The encoding tail leaves every corrected sum `w` on a hyperplane bank and leaves `(q, v_N)` on the FULL banks. It uses 104 lifts and 104 drops. The 208 data registers are still 104 banks of dimension 9 and 104 of dimension 8, the same multiset as the channel exit. A coverage law that scores only that multiset credits the tail no new endpoint progress.

The FULL banks are not a renaming of `x` and not a renaming of `-y`. Every row and every column of `B` is nonzero, and `B B^t = 12 I_8`. The hyperplane banks are exactly `w`.

Under the paired-chain constants (idle `39096`, capacity `60736`, channel mass `2368`), crediting `c` rank units of payload progress per call gives

```text
M(0) = (62280 - 9c) / 60736.
```

`M(0) = 7785/7592 > 1` at `c = 0`. The comparison is strictly below 1 only for `c > 1544/9`. Integer credit needs `c >= 172`. Omitting the later fixed-location restoration does not lower the 208, because those conversions are the tail itself.

This is a scoped necessary screen plus exact finite checks. It is not a new supplier, a physical owner map, or a multiplication theorem.

## Task and overlap

Base `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. Card `p104-side-correction`, priority revision 7, scope refined.

Session r33, item 1 of the ordered eligible list in the package README. Open handoffs from the 19 October index come first. This item is discussion comment 19030045 and open question 1 of `research/p104-role-exchange-caller-audit`.

Nearest work: `research/p104-role-exchange-residue` (the encoding) and `research/p104-role-exchange-caller-audit` (the fixed-location 192-rank adapter and the open in-place question). Different from this account's encoded-exit, `(N-P)⊗M`, literal-slot, chart, fiber and helper-gate notes.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B research/p104-slotfree-coverage/verify.py
python3 -O -B research/p104-slotfree-coverage/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-slotfree-coverage
```

The direct checker prints `PASS_P104_SLOTFREE_COVERAGE full=104 hyperplane=104 conversions=208 M0=7785/7592 credit>1544/9 integer_credit>=172 no_new_kappa=true`. Metadata replay prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-slotfree-coverage outcome=partial`.

The verifier hashes the pinned geometry, rebuilds the 104 ports, replays the tail on all 208 linear forms, and checks the screen at credits `0`, `1544/9`, `171` and `172`. A zero `B` row is used only as a control that a pure source coordinate would have matched `x`.

Finite checks corroborate the written identities. They are not a native signed-floor replay. Not run: Lean, Docker, the selected cold replay, and any search for a payload-sensitive law that awards the credit.

## Credit

Clear1nsight (`research/p104-role-exchange-residue` and `research/p104-role-exchange-caller-audit`); the paired-chain constants in `docs/research/p104-side-correction-scope-map.md` from the PR2082/PR2083 contract; `notes/copied-centers-complex.tex` for the two-stage scalar target; Rohan Arun and Chafik Boukhalfa for the channel and puncture.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance.

## Open next questions

The package question is whether a payload-sensitive coverage law can award more than `1544/9` rank units per call to the in-place `(q, v_N)` banks. The dimension multiset cannot. The first check is one idle endpoint that `q` or `v_N` actually retires. The blocker is that no such endpoint is exhibited here.

A separate question is the sharp FULL-operand lift count of a schedule that emits `(-y, w)` when the final bank names may differ from the original slots. The 192-rank tariff assumes those original names.
